refresh_tokens_self_select.name: refresh_tokens_self_select
refresh_tokens_self_select.using:
EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM sessions s
        WHERE s.id = "refresh_tokens"."session_id"
          AND s.user_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid
      )

users_tenant_member_select.name: users_tenant_member_select
users_tenant_member_select.using:
EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM memberships m
        WHERE m.user_id = "users"."id"
          AND m.tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid
      )

events_published_ck.name: events_published_ck
events_published_ck.value: "events"."status" <> 'published' OR ("events"."starts_at" IS NOT NULL AND "events"."location" IS NOT NULL)

charges_origin_ck.name: charges_origin_ck
charges_origin_ck.value:
("charges"."origin" = 'plan' AND "charges"."academy_plan_id" IS NOT NULL AND "charges"."event_registration_id" IS NULL AND "charges"."order_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("charges"."origin" = 'event' AND "charges"."event_registration_id" IS NOT NULL AND "charges"."academy_plan_id" IS NULL AND "charges"."order_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("charges"."origin" = 'order' AND "charges"."order_id" IS NOT NULL AND "charges"."academy_plan_id" IS NULL AND "charges"."event_registration_id" IS NULL)
